note: Client prediction vectors (generated by web/js/engine/test/gen-physics-vectors.mjs from shared/ref/sim.mjs + web/js/engine/physics.js). quant.yaw/pitch: [raw, wire] after normalise+q4 (yaw kept inside (-PI,PI]). predict: raw = [keys,yawRaw,pitchRaw,buttons,slot]; wire = [seq,keys,yaw,pitch,buttons,slot] as sent; expect[i] = [x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,onGround] after simulateInput of wire[i]; acts[i] = weapon actions; finalWs = ws array at the end. reconcile: the server applies wire inputs `lag` ticks late and snapshots every 2 ticks; snaps[].after is the client state after reconcile+replay (must equal straight prediction, maxCorrection ~0). interp: [a,b,t,lerpAngle].
